name: Black Desert
text: The Black Desert (Arabic: الصحراء السوداء, aṣ-Ṣaḥrāʾ as-sawdāʾ) is a region of volcano-shaped and widely spaced mounds, distributed along about 30 km (19 mi) in the Western Desert of Egypt between the White Desert in the south and the Bahariya Oasis in the north. Most of its mounds are capped by basalt sills, giving them the characteristic black color.

depictions.name: Black Desert
depictions.text: The Black Desert is a mountainous desert region located in Egypt, characterized by its dolerite volcanic hills, located south of Siwa and west of Faiyum. The tomb of the Egyptian nomarch Tefibi III was located in the southern part of the region and was situated atop an Isu vault. Around 48 BCE, the Medjay Bayek of Siwa explored the tomb, gaining access to the vault below.
